python -c "import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(1)
base=Path('research/experiments/v6-physical1m-learning-curve-20260831').resolve()
sys.path.insert(0,str(base))
import run_curve as run
from alpha_holdem.policy_contract_v6 import validate_metadata
path=base/'production/checkpoints/checkpoint_iter000004_hands000000016582.pt'
before=run.sha(path)
payload=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
source=torch.load(run.SOURCE,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
validate_metadata(payload)
account=payload['environment_hand_accounting']
assert payload['iteration']==4 and payload['run_id']==run.RUN_ID
assert account['prefix_complete'] and account['unknown_prefix_training_marker_hands']==0
assert account['origin_run_id']==run.RUN_ID
assert account['completed_hands']==sum(w['completed_hands'] for w in account['session_worker_counts'])
assert len(payload['model'])==86 and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in payload['model'].values())
assert sum(not torch.equal(v,source['model'][k]) for k,v in payload['model'].items())==86
assert len(payload['optimizer']['state'])==86
steps=[]
for state in payload['optimizer']['state'].values():
    assert float(state['step'])>0 and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state.values() if isinstance(v,torch.Tensor))
    steps.append(float(state['step']))
copies=run.read(base/'execution_code/copy_manifest.json')
anchors=run.read(base/'anchor_manifest.json')
run.verify(copies,anchors)
assert before==run.sha(path)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',iteration=4,physical_hands=account['completed_hands'],legacy_markers=payload['total_hands'],finite_changed_tensors=86,adam_step_range=[min(steps),max(steps)],sha256=before,source_pairs_verified=len(copies),new_validation_hands=0)))"
